player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.wrong_format: You did not respond with valid '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ulandik'a kongolo ya ndundu eyi nga si na bombo.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Ulijaribu ku sende disk kutoka tower empty.
invalid_move.same_tower: Ulijaribu ku sende dishi mu tower nderi.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Ulijaribu kuweka disk kubwa kwenye diski ndogo.

outcome.win: Congratulations! Wa solve the bridge of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Cjk ck, limite d'un chemin est atteint. You have correctly placed {pct}% of the disks on Tower C.
